svg.title: Retry and Timeout nesting
svg.desc: Two rows, each with a small tree on the left and a time line on the right; the time axis runs from 0 to 0.7 seconds. Tag 1: Retry above Timeout above act. Three red bars, attempts starting at 0.00, 0.22, 0.44 seconds, each about 0.2 seconds long; the step fails at 0.64 seconds. Tag 2: Timeout above Retry above act. One red bar from 0 to 0.20 seconds, where the step fails.
